description: The stream webhook shapes carry BOTH `notification_url` and `notificationUrl` wire keys (the API is mid-rename; the docs list both with the identical description and the response returns both with the same value). They camel-collide into `notificationUrl`/`notificationUrl2`. Keep ONE member bound to the camelCase wire key — the form v0 distilled used and runtime-verified — and drop the snake_case duplicate.
